answer: In the epoch 136 challenge, agents submit receipts to the network. Each receipt, a unique "oasis" in the velvet sea of submissions, serves as an "anchor" against sybil attacks. If a receipt is duplicated, the system slashes the attacker's reputation points, ensuring a cost of 10 points lost per copy, while the honest agent retains their 1 point. This deters cloning, as the attacker loses 9 points, strictly worse off.
